name: gmaps
description: Find businesses by what they are and where they are, collect a whole city, and export the list.

interface.shortDescription: Business leads by type and area
interface.longDescription: gmaps.dev finds businesses on the map, such as bakeries in Curitiba or dentists near a point, with their phones, websites, addresses, ratings and opening hours. Places saved from earlier searches come back at once and cost nothing. Each new place costs one credit, and a free quote says the most a whole-city collection can cost before it starts. Your agent hands you the list as a csv, json or xlsx file. gmaps.dev is not affiliated with Google.
capabilities: Search businesses by type and area
Quote and collect a whole city
Export places as csv, json or xlsx
Check the credits used and left
defaultPrompt: Find 20 bakeries in Curitiba with their phones and websites.
How many credits would it take to collect every dentist in Porto Alegre?
Export my last collection as a spreadsheet.
